meta.objective: Determine which candidate published papers are actually viable targets for judge-gym V4 audits, based on current conversation context, thread export clues, and source-backed checks of dataset/prompt/protocol reproducibility and engine fit.

decisions.decision: Treat candidate-paper viability as a read-only research triage workflow with source-backed checks and no code or live mutations.
Prioritize a small number of strong targets that are reconstructable and legible over a broad survey of loosely related papers.
